method: Every page of the extraction was compared with its printed page image by an AI reader; 1,138 corrections were proposed; 1,027 were applied after a second reader (reading 200 dpi page halves) confirmed them or they were plainly non-words. This is a machine reading, not human review.

residualCheck.note: A fresh, unprompted check of a random sample after the corrections were applied.
residualCheck.cosmeticMeaning: the book prints Latin digits where the extraction has Bangla digits, and spelling variants such as তাড়িত/তড়িৎ, তৈরী/তৈরি
residualCheck.followUp: The genuine errors found (উল্ট লেন্স, ফ্রেমিং) were fixed everywhere they occur.

excluded.why: The parser turned graphs into tables of values that are not in the book.

knownGaps: About 49 section headings are missing from the passages; section labels on passages are unreliable and are not used for retrieval.
54 figures have a wrong, cropped or missing picture file; text that points to a figure whose picture is missing is flagged (missingFigures).
An estimated 1% of passages still carry a spelling error, and rarely a wrong word; no human has read the book.
Digits are normalised to Bangla in prose; the printed book often uses Latin digits.
